job.job_description:
Hiring: GenAI Engineer / Agentic AI Developer

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)
Experience: 58 Years

We are looking for a passionate GenAI Engineer / Agentic AI Developer to build and deploy next-generation AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Key Responsibilities

Develop AI applications using LLMs such as OpenAI GPT, Claude, Gemini, or open-source models (Llama, Mistral, etc.)
Build Agentic AI workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or MCP
Design and implement RAG-based solutions with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or Azure AI Search
Develop scalable backend APIs using Python/FastAPI and integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications
Optimize LLM performance through prompt engineering, evaluation, and retrieval optimization
Deploy and maintain AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready AI applications

Required Skills

Strong programming skills in Python
Hands-on experience with LLMs and Prompt Engineering
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or MCP
Strong knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search
Experience building REST APIs and backend services
Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP
Good understanding of AI evaluation, monitoring, and optimization

Preferred Skills

Experience with Llama, Mistral, Qwen, or other open-source LLMs
Multi-agent orchestration and autonomous AI systems
Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and MLOps
Conversational AI, AI Copilots, or enterprise AI applications

Why Join?

Work on cutting-edge Generative AI & Agentic AI projects
Opportunity to build enterprise-scale AI solutions
Collaborative and innovation-driven environment
Exposure to global clients and advanced AI technologies

If you're interested, please share your updated resume
